/**
   * @typedef {object} SyncAccounts
   * @property {Array} calendars - The account's calendars.
   * @property {Array} addressBooks - The account's address books.
   */

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted typedef describes an object with calendars and addressBooks arrays, and #addSyncAccounts accesses those fields. Its @param currently spells SyncAccounts[] even though the code takes one object. The historical 1382 tag was @type instead of @param. For this specific API comment, recommend describing one SyncAccounts object, so a caller does not infer an array-of-objects contract. This is a scoped manual documentation proposal, not a runtime bug or a new lint rule. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: SyncAccounts is one object with two arrays at the add boundary
